text:
Nadia: Quick heads-up 1: I opened a PR that consolidates the region availability notes and adds a small migration paragraph for customers moving from /regions to /geo. Wanted to flag a couple problems before reviews.
Julio: Thanks Nadia. Where did you put the migration snippet? I couldn't find it in the top-level docs page.
Nadia: It's in the new matrix doc under the "Supported regions" section, but it's currently using a generic example of `eu-central-1` for embeddings which I don't think is accurate anymore.
Priya (devex): I'll check. We recently enabled embeddings in eu-north-1 for some customers; eu-central-1 is still partial. Could we make the example region-agnostic or show how to pick the right endpoint programmatically?
Nadia: Yes, I tried to add a tiny code sample showing how to detect available regions from the /v1/regions endpoint, but the snippet was messy.
Julio: Suggestion: show a small JS snippet that fetches /v1/regions and picks the first region that supports embeddings. Keeps the docs accurate longer.
Priya (devex): I'll replace the hardcoded example with this JS sample:
```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/regions', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
const regions = await res.json();
const embedRegion = regions.find(r => r.features.includes('embeddings'))?.id || 'us-west-2';
// use embedRegion for subsequent requests
```
Nadia: Nice. Also: legal asked to add one short localization caveat about language parity per region. legal-bot posted the exact line: "Locale coverage may vary by region; check the region matrix and contact sales for contractual residency guarantees."
Sam K: Confirmed we have embeddings in eu-north-1 and eu-west-2 only for EU customers today; update the matrix to reflect eu-north-1, eu-west-2 (embeddings) and mark eu-central-1 as "planned". We'll keep /v1/regions as the authoritative source.
Nadia: Good. Two more small things: 1) the PR references an old docs path `/docs/regions/embeddings` which should be `/docs/geo/embeddings`, and 2) the table had a broken link to the residency guide.
Priya (devex): I fixed the internal links in the branch and added a footnote near the matrix: "Data residency indicates where the inference executes; Dedicated/Private deployments can be configured for strict residency." Kept it one sentence as legal requested.
deploy-bot: staging deploy for branch docs/pr-3498 queued 1 - build 8910.
Julio: Linter flagged the new table for accessibility (missing table summary). I added a `summary` attribute and a short caption.
Sam K: FYI infra is opening a ticket to track eu-central-1 parity with eu-west-2; won't block docs merge but will be linked in the PR.
Nadia: Final asks before merging: - swap hardcoded region examples for dynamic /v1/regions snippet (Priya) - update matrix to list eu-north-1, eu-west-2 as embeddings-enabled and mark others planned (Sam) - fix all /docs/regions links to /docs/geo (Priya) - add the exact legal one-liner and link to residency guide (Nadia).
Priya (devex): All done, pushed. Also added a tiny note on locale suffixes for SDKs (`region` param) and a quick example for the HTTP header: 
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Redwood-Region: eu-north-1
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
```
Nadia: Great. If staging (build 8910) passes and nobody objects by tomorrow noon, I'll merge.
legal-bot: Reminder: additions to residency language were reviewed by Legal on 2025-11-02.
Sam K: I'll follow up in the infra ticket after investigation and attach it to the PR.
Nadia: Thanks team 1 :shipit:
